name: 28672-random1k1k-70bfp8-4gpu
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3, four GPUs of one a3 node (--gres=gpu:4), NVLink between them, nothing else on the cards.
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1; one in-process vLLM engine on one node.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 80 layers, 64 query heads over 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden_size 8192, vocab 128256; bf16 activations over ModelOpt FP8 weights (~70 GB), FP8 KV cache by the checkpoint's own declaration.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams = 64, warmup 20%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 960 requests with a 3600 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, fixed 1024 prompt tokens / 1024 output tokens (min = max = nominal on both), request_format plain, temperature 0.0.
purpose: A 70B assistant drafting page-length answers from page-length prompts for 64 concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
model: nvidia/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-FP8
tensor-parallel-size: 4
dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
enable-prefix-caching: false

# At this commit `mode` is the CompilationMode field (`level` also exists and is not it), and
# `pass_config` holds the fusion-pass switches. Drop any one of these keys and the engine starts
# cleanly and serves a configuration nobody declared -- check the startup log that each took.
compilation-config:
  mode: 3
  splitting_ops: []
  use_inductor_graph_partition: false
  cudagraph_mode: FULL
  pass_config:
    enable_sp: true
    fuse_gemm_comms: true

# Written down rather than left to resolve: an in-process launch falls through to the engine's
# 2048 default, a quarter of the width declared here.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-model-len: 4096
